question: Should this MiMo/Discord latest-release leak wait for a raw provider/transcript/outbound payload capture before any repair path is chosen?
rationale: The issue crosses a hidden-reasoning security boundary, but current source normally maps `reasoning_content` to thinking and the related open PR does not prove this MiMo path, so automation cannot safely choose the fix layer.

options.title: Require MiMo payload proof first
options.body: Ask for or produce a redacted current-main Discord run showing provider deltas, transcript content blocks, and outbound payload before choosing a provider or delivery-layer fix.

options.title: Fold into the older Discord leak track
options.body: Treat this as another datapoint on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/96849 and have that work explicitly prove the MiMo token-plan path before closure.

options.title: Authorize a narrow exploratory fix
options.body: Let a maintainer sponsor a focused investigation PR, but keep it behind security review until real behavior proof shows the leak is gone.

recommendation.title: Require MiMo payload proof first
recommendation.body: Ask for or produce a redacted current-main Discord run showing provider deltas, transcript content blocks, and outbound payload before choosing a provider or delivery-layer fix.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work covers both Discord reasoning delivery and OpenAI-compatible reasoning-detail parsing, the two central boundaries in this report.
